variants.name: 棱镜折射
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished desktop first-viewport website design screenshot for the existing Chinese product AI Creative Lab. Wide 1920x1080 / 16:9 landscape, full bleed webpage with no browser frame, no mockup device, no outer border, no captions. Version A: PRISM / optical refraction. This is a new design inspired only by the supplied reference's pure black background, white typography, sharp white light, physically refracted saturated rainbow and smoked optical glass material. Do not reproduce the vgpu name or its UI.
Visual: at least 75% of the screen remains absolute #000000 black. Beautiful precision optical glass triangular hollow prism standing on the RIGHT half, oversized but entire silhouette visible, dark black glass with crisp white rim highlights. A single narrow brilliant white beam enters from far right, travels through prism and spreads toward lower-left as thin distinct spectral red orange yellow green cyan blue bands. Light stays mainly in the lower third; never crosses the main heading or input text. Photoreal 3D glass, optical studio quality; restrained bloom, no stars, no nebula, no dark blue background, no purple ambient fog. This is the original reference's optical energy interpreted as a creative lab.
Real webpage UI composited cleanly over it. Top navigation 76px high with x=80px left margin, same line: small white AI/sail brand mark then exact brand "AI Creative Lab". Middle nav exact "Products", "Research", "Lab", "Resources", "爆款工作室". Top-right "中文" then small dark outlined button "登录". Small crisp white / muted gray nav.
Left hero column starts around x=170, y=260, width 660. Above heading a very muted model strip "GPT Image 2.6   ·   Veo 3.1   ·   MiniMax H3". Large 78px bold modern Chinese sans-serif white heading split into TWO lines verbatim: "创作灵感，" and "成为灵感". Below exact gray subtitle "探索发现，让灵感先做一次实验". Ample deliberate black negative space.
Under subtitle a large usable dark composer box width 640px, height 180px, near-black #0c0c0c fill, 1px subtle #303030 border, 18px corner radius. Placeholder at upper-left exact "描述你想创作的内容…". At bottom-left a plus icon then exact "视频   图片   音频" in gray with small simple line icons. Bottom-right white pill button with black exact text "开始创作" and arrow. The composer is fully opaque and readable; spectral light behind it cannot obscure any content.
Composition polished real SaaS landing UI, high contrast, quiet clean typography, restrained luxury. All text must be legible and accurate. No additional text, badges, metrics, cards, second section or visible design-version title. Keep generous safe margins.
